author: C

checks.factual: Read all affected sets and checked new primary-source observations, revised familiar identifications, chronology and qualifiers. Source retrieval restrictions are recorded separately, rather than treated as factual verification.
checks.translation: Compared every EN/ET question, response, accepted variant and explanation in each affected category. Required parallel Palm/TiVo hints, corrected inflected own-answer denomination word and dated Tallink scope.
checks.independence: Read all five-question sets including revealed explanations; tea oxidation enumeration replaced by tea bag; weekday enumeration broken by Janus/January; generic robot/orbiting-object targets disambiguated.
checks.difficulty: Reviewed identifiable lower-tier cues and more specific higher-tier targets while preserving assigned difficulty and tiers. Editorial calibration is not a representative player study.
checks.attribution: Reviewed per-source title/URL/licence, genuine copyright terms, Wikipedia CC licences and historical OpenTDB candidate provenance. Original factual wording avoids copying restricted passages.
